name: Profile-Likelihood Identifiability Analysis
name_zh: 剖面似然可辨识性分析
summary: Assess whether observed trajectories constrain model parameters uniquely or only weakly.
summary_zh: 通过固定单个参数并重优化其他参数构造剖面似然，区分结构与实践不可辨识性。
core_idea: Optimize nuisance parameters along slices of a selected parameter and examine likelihood profiles.
innovation: Separates structural and data-limited identifiability limitations beyond optimizer convergence.
limitations: Depends on a valid observation/noise model.

start_here.why: Classical accessible example of practical versus structural identifiability with partial observations.
start_here.focus: Profile construction and interpretation of flat/unbounded directions.

curation_note: Representative primary or authoritative scholarly source has been checked; the suggested starting reference is optional, not a required reading quota.
